entities.name: Ludwig Mies van der Rohe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludwig Mies van der Rohe was a German and American architect, academic, and interior designer. He was commonly referred to as Mies, his surname. He is regarded as one of the pioneers of modern architecture.
